Coming Soon To Shudder: ‘INFIRMARY’

Christine Burnham 1 day ago News, Trailers Leave a comment

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by

Coming soon to Shudder from director Nicholas Pineda (Disquiet) is a new horror film: Infirmary. The film stars Paul Syre Lee (Pachinko – TV Series), Mark Anthony Williams (Suits LA – TV Series), and Danielle Kennedy (Narcos – TV Series).
